outcome: Ultrasonographic findings of the explanted uteroplacental interface
cohort: 34 pregnant patients aged 18 years and older with a prior cesarean delivery and antenatal diagnosis of lower uterine segment PAS who underwent cesarean hysterectomy
finding: Findings suggest that PAS severity is likely mediated by progressive scar dehiscence and uterine remodeling, not placental invasion, challenging the existence of in situ invasive percreta as it is currently described.
